questions.question: How do I book my free trial lesson?
questions.answer: Head to our [contact page](contact.html) and fill out the short enquiry form. We'll get back to you within 24 hours to find a time that suits you at our Canberra studio.

questions.question: What instruments do you teach?
questions.answer: We currently offer private lessons in piano, violin, cello, flute and voice, as well as music theory and musicianship. See our [lessons page](lessons.html) for details on each.

questions.question: What age can my child start?
questions.answer: Most children are ready for piano or violin from around five years old. Flute is usually best from about eight, and voice from around ten. Adults are always welcome — it's never too late to start.

questions.question: Do I need my own instrument?
questions.answer: For your trial lesson we can usually provide an instrument in the studio. For regular lessons you'll need one at home to practise on — we're happy to advise on buying or renting good-quality instruments.

questions.question: Where are lessons held?
questions.answer: Our dedicated studio is in Canberra. Once your lesson is confirmed we'll send you the full address and parking details. Online lessons are also available.

questions.question: Do students have to sit exams?
questions.answer: Not at all. Many students enjoy the structure of AMEB or Trinity exams, but they're entirely optional. We'll set goals that motivate you, whether that's a certificate, a performance or a favourite piece.

questions.question: How much should I practise?
questions.answer: Little and often is best. Young beginners might practise 10–15 minutes a day; advanced students closer to an hour. Your teacher will give you a clear, realistic practice plan each week.

questions.question: Can parents sit in on lessons?
questions.answer: Yes — especially for young beginners, a parent in the room helps practice at home. There's also a comfortable waiting area if you'd prefer to step out.

questions.question: Are there performance opportunities?
questions.answer: Kreutzer is a young studio, and organising our first student recital is one of our goals. Ask your teacher about performance goals that suit you.

questions.question: How much do lessons cost?
questions.answer: A 30-minute lesson is $63 on its own, or as little as $52 per lesson when booked as a 10-lesson pack. See the [full fee schedule](terms.html#payment) for longer lessons and advanced rates.

questions.question: What if I need to cancel a lesson?
questions.answer: Please give at least 24 hours' notice to reschedule a lesson. Full details are in our [terms and conditions](terms.html).

questions.question: How do I pay?
questions.answer: Lessons are paid in advance by bank transfer, PayID or cash. We'll send an invoice with each package.
